commit_message: Keep AI Studio responsive during ACP startup
pr_title: Keep AI Studio responsive during ACP startup
pr_body:
## Summary

- move ACP provider discovery, Managed Local/Goose startup, process launch, and ACP session negotiation off the egui frame thread
- preserve Agent Host session/run binding authority by preparing bindings before startup and revalidating them when an opened session is attached
- add pollable startup progress, duplicate-Send blocking, Ask/Build cancellation, and cleanup for late startup completion
- add controlled regression tests for delayed discovery/session open, initialize failure, and cancellation cleanup
- add deterministic AI Studio visual evidence for loading, Stop state, transcript, and startup error presentation

## Validation

Request Windows affected validation and Editor visual validation.
